hook: Police chases are about to get *a lot harder*
caption:
GTA 6 is about to get delayed again just so Rockstar can add the new Tesla Roadster.

In this AI-generated video, the Roadster gets chased by police through the city before running into a massive roadblock. Its thrusters then kick in, launching the car over the entire blockade before landing back on the highway.

With Tesla's recent Roadster reveal, people are already imagining some insane possibilities.

And well, this would make for a pretty incredible GTA 6 getaway.
